description: Four notes spread across a bar. At 90 BPM, for four bars, the course project at this stage plays C3 on steps 1, 5, 9 and 13 of each bar at velocity 80, half a step long, so the same note falls once every two thirds of a second. Listen for the pulse thinning out from the six notes a second of the first stage to a slow, even four in a bar.
